item.title: Dynamic Solvent Participation Drives Sodium Storage in Oxygen Engineered Hard Carbon
item.description:
مهندسی اکسیژن سطحی hard carbon مشتق از cellulose با اسید سیتریک، ظرفیت ۴۰۰ mAh/g و بازده کولمبی اولیه ۹۱٪ در الکترولیت diglyme را با نقش solvation layer فراهم می‌کند.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Surface oxygen engineering of cellulose-derived hard carbon via citric acid yields 400 mAh·g⁻¹ and 91% initial Coulombic efficiency. In situ characterization reveals charge-transfer resistance cycles with sodium storage state, evidencing dynamic solvation layer formation and solvent participation. This validates the "adsorption–closed pore filling" pathway and establishes interfacial solvation structure as key to sodium storage kinetics.
🏷 hard carbon anode · sodium-ion battery · oxygen engineering · solvation structure · closed pore filling

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using a NaNO₃-DMSO additive to build a LiF/NaF–N-rich interphase via dual-ion synergy, preserving carbonate solvation while enabling early anion reduction. This stabilizes silicon-carbon anodes, delivering 1000-cycle durability and 85–95% capacity retention in full cells. It offers a practical strategy for durable Si-based lithium-ion batteries.

item.title: Indispensable Interphase Passivation in Solvation‐Regulated Propylene Carbonate Electrolytes for Ah‐Level Lithium‐Ion Batteries at −50–120°C
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work decouples solvation regulation from interphase passivation in propylene carbonate electrolytes, revealing that solvation engineering alone fails at high currents where Li⁺-PC co-intercalation occurs at exposed graphite sites. A continuous SEI is indispensable. The optimized electrolyte enables 1.0 Ah graphite||NCM83 pouch cells with 93.5% initial Coulombic efficiency, 2000-cycle stability, and −50–120°C operation.
🏷 propylene carbonate · solid electrolyte interphase · lithium-ion battery · wide-temperature · graphite anode

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work breaks the conductivity–self-healing tradeoff in hydrogel electrolytes via a PVA-borax/Zn(OTf)₂ network achieving 45.77 mS cm⁻¹. Its novelty is a cascade bulk–interfacial Zn²⁺ transport synergy: low-barrier hopping plus a conductive SEI, alongside solvation-sheath reconfiguration. item.title: A Hybrid Phosphate–Ether Electrolyte for High-Temperature and High-Safety 18650 Cylindrical Sodium-Ion Batteries
item.description:
الکترولیت هیبریدی TEP/THF غیرقابل اشتعال برای باتری‌های سدیم-یون دما بالا طراحی شد که پایداری چرخه‌ای و ایمنی عالی در سلول‌های 18650 نشان می‌دهد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a nonflammable TEP/THF hybrid electrolyte where weakly coordinating THF boosts anion-derived inorganic interphases and fast Na+ transport. Significance: 18650 cylindrical SIBs achieve 80.6% capacity retention after 300 cycles at 80 °C, pass nail penetration without combustion (peak 88.9 °C), and support layered oxide cathodes, enabling high-temperature, high-safety grid storage.
